notes: Raw TS1/TS2 storage buckets are physical alternatives; intervals must be aligned to UTC.
TS5 MAX/AVG resolution is part of the query semantics (1 minute / 1 hour). It is not the same as the storage partition bucket.
M2/M3/M4/M5 are carried forward as activated modifiers; this stage does not silently invent concrete settings.
No compaction, TTL, salt, benchmark score or throughput estimate is inferred here.
